text: Kennen is a Wildhammer dwarf stable master located at Firebeard's Patrol in the Twilight Highlands.

Keric Smolderblade is a Dark Iron dwarf warlock trainer located in the Forlorn Cavern in Ironforge. He is one of the Dark Iron dwarves that stayed with Moira Thaurissan after her reunion with the dwarves of Ironforge. He is found talking with Thistleheart in Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms.
Keri Thunderbrew is a dwarf alcohol vendor found at Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands. Keri fell during the Iron Horde attack.
Kevin Geissler is a human blacksmith in Tol Barad Peninsula.
Kenral Nightwind is a night elf rogue trainer located at Lor'danel in Darkshore.
Kevin is a human child walking around inside James Clark's house at the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest.
Kevin Rucker is a member of the World of Warcraft animation team.
Kendall Covington is a human located at Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.

Khadgar's Tower is a mage tower summoned by Khadgar at the optimal confluence of arcane energies in the Zangarra of Talador. It is built on one or more ley lines. managed to infiltrate the tower and stabbed Khadgar. During the Burning Legion's third invasion of Azeroth, champions of the Tirisgarde returned here to find Zooti Fizzlefury, but encountered hostile podlings.
Kevin Starr is a Night elf located at the Lunarfall Shipyard.
Kerraelon Sunhunger is a blood elf follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Kelok Frostblade is an orc vendor located outside the Wor'gol in Frostfire Ridge.
Kelli Greenfield is a human located at the Old Coast Path in Azsuna.

Kesalon is a human mage of the Kirin Tor. He was first seen as Undermage Kesalon in the Violet Bluff in the Everbloom as the only survivor of the Primal attack and the subsequent infestation of the Kirin Tor at the Bluff. He was later promoted to Archmage Kesalon and can be found in various locations around the Broken Isles.
Kerzug is an orc. He has a son named Zungal and a granddaughter named .
Kelissa Stilwell is a blood elf located in Tirisfal Glades. She assists the adventurer during The Silver Hand (quest) alongside Lyanae, Shieldbearer Anak, and Helda the Breaker.
Kevina Martens was a human located at Tradewinds Market in Boralus. She was removed during the alpha and her ID was reused for Vindicator Jaelaana who now acts as emissary for the 7th Legion.
Kendra Smith is a human located in the Roughneck Camp in Tiragarde Sound.
Kevin Tack is a human located in Hops, Line, & Sinker Brewing in Boralus.
Kelorr was an orc whose scouting party was ambushed by the Warmaul ogres. The orc perished along with Det'rak.
Kevin Martens is a team member of the World of Warcraft team.
Kevin Young is a human located at Trollbane Hall in Arathi Basin where he runs the local blacksmith.
Kelrath is an orc who would be present in the Bonetown Scenario.

Kery'nael Thorngale is a night elf member of the Druids of the Flame who planned with her sister Solarys to leave the cult. While Solarys went first, she expected her siblings to come as well. An adventurer, sent by Solarys, found him at the Smoldering Copse in the Emerald Dream, surrounded by Slain Lunarwing Darters and a Singed Lunarwing Juvenile and Innocent Lunarwing Hatchling.

Kilnar Goldensword was a high elf sorceress and native of Dalaran. Kilnar had several polite encounters with Daelin Proudmoore that led to the birth of a half-elven daughter, Finnall Goldensword. Kilnar raised her daughter by herself in Dalaran informing her daughter of her father when she came on age. Kilnar was killed by Arthas himself when the Scourge attacked Dalaran.

Khan Gragtor was a level 14 Kolkar clan centaur khan, who tore an orc village asunder and took several orcs as unwilling slaves to do his bidding. Rexxar found the centaur camp and orc captives locked in cages. The orc Mathogg asked Rexxar to kill Gragtor and take his iron key as it was the only thing that could open the cages. Rexxar razed the centaur camp to the ground and cut the khan to pieces.

Kharan Mighthammer is a level 52 elite dwarf imprisoned in the Blackrock Depths detention block. He was assigned by King Magni Bronzebeard to watch over his daughter, Princess Moira Bronzebeard but was unable to fulfill his task.

Kildar is an orc wolf riding trainer located in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar. Following the War of the Thorns, the Horde built bestiaries near the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore. Alliance champions set them ablaze and encountered Kildar.
Khardan Proudblade is a night elf weapon vendor located in Aldrassil in Teldrassil. It is unknown whether he survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
Khara Deepwater is a dwarf fishing and fish vendor located on the western bank of the Loch in Loch Modan.

Kilrim is an orc barbarian. He trusts only those who are independent or Horde-affiliated. He was forced into gladiatorial games at the Gurubashi Arena in Stranglethorn Vale. He was summoned to fight in the arena by two large troll guards that went to his cell. He and Parla, a young goblin rogue, stood and exited through the barred gate, casting sidelong glances at each other, knowing the danger they were being sent into. After a short time, they returned with Kilrim leaning on Parla. The orc lacked his right hand and a white rag was wrapped around his forearm — which was turning red rapidly. Naith, a tauren, rushed up to heal him when all the other prisoners were slow to act. Having been mai
Kill Shot is a row 1 hunter talent. It's automatically granted to Marksmanship hunters.

Killoren was the husband of Vivian and a fallen hero of Lordaeron. He is the father of Thassarian and Leryssa. It was his spirit that Thassarian saw at Light's Hope Chapel, and helped to free him from the Lich King's control. Originally he was buried in Lordaeron but was moved to Light's Hope Chapel.
Killing Streak is a hunter talent in the Beast Mastery tree.

Khan Leh'Prah (also written Leh'prah) is the leader of the Kolkar centaur of Desolace. During his questline, adventurers help him unite the centaur of the Kolkar, Gelkis, and Magram clans to take back Shok'Thokar from the Burning Blade cult.

Killick is a human found in Northwatch Hold within the Southern Barrens. He is seen speaking with a Northwatch Dockworker and behind him is Gilthares Firebough. He makes a comment when the Captain's silver from the Box of Cutlery is used as ammo for the cannons. It is unknown whether he survived the Razing of Northwatch Hold or not.

Kihra is a night elf located at the Lunarfall in . She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn. Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore, like many other followers, she appears in Stormwind Harbor at the sparring ring, where champions duel in preparation for the assault on the Broken Shore.
Kilandric Hawkstrike is a night elf located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Kia Herman is a human member of SI:7 seen in Telaari Station in .
Killga is an orc leatherworking trainer and vendor located at the Axefall‎ in Spires of Arak.
Killer Cobra is a row 10 Beast Mastery hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Piercing Fangs.
Khardon Timberdawn is a night elf innkeeper located at Lightsong in southern Val'sharah.
Khargus Stonemantle is a dwarf located in Silithus: The Wound. He is responsible for studying samples of :Azerite recovered from the dig site around the Wound.
Kieran Stonebrow is a dwarf located at the Black Market in the Underbelly. He is in trouble with Madam Goya as his payment for a set of Dreadnaught's Battlegear has been lost in the mail.
Kiki Castillo is a human located at Fort Daelin in Stormsong Valley.

Khansguard Akato is the leader of Khanam Matra Sarest's khansguard, located at the entrance to Sarest's chambers atop the krutal in Maruukai in the Ohn'ahran Plains. After Clan Nokhud betray the other clans, Akato sends adventurers to thin the Nokhud's numbers. Akato and his fellow guards Hojin and Jebotai accompany Sarest to the Horn of Drusahl after it is attacked by the Nokhud. She orders them and Scout Tomul to stay behind and defend a position outside the village while she and the adventurers advance inside. __NOTOC__
Kholv is a void elf located in the Ohn'ahran Plains. Kholv sits beside Mishka and Daesii Rae.

Kira Songshine is a wandering human drink and bread vendor located either on the roads north from Goldshire to Stormwind, east towards the Tower of Azora or south-west towards the Westbrook Garrison, in Elwynn Forest. Jimmy Blackridge fancied her since they were children but was not able to tell her. After his time spent as a buccaneer he told Kira all about his pirate adventure some time after. Kira showed clear interest in James.
Kirk Maxwell is a human stable master located at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.

King Jokkum is the lord of the frost giants and the leader of the Sons of Hodir. He resides in the Sons' home base of Dun Niffelem in the Storm Peaks, along with his frostworg companion, Oloh. Jokkum's father, Arngrim the Insatiable, had been King of the frost giants when Thorim, once their greatest ally, suddenly turned on them. The Stormlord had been tricked by his brother, Loken, into thinking that the frost giants were responsible for the death of Thorim's wife Sif. Many long years later, when Thorim was roused from his stupor by players, the Stormlord decided to set things right and restore his friendship with the frost giants. Over the course of several quests, Jokkum and his brethren
King Phaoris is the racial leader of the Ramkahen tribe of tol'vir, and is located in the town of Ramkahen in Uldum.
Kinna Persworth is a human found at Halfhill Market in the Valley of the Four Winds.
Kirandros Galeheart is a night elf located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.

Kinja is an orc located in the Frostwall's Forge. She accepts True Iron Ore work orders creating Truesteel Ingots. Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore, she appears at the Dranosh'ar Blockade, working at the forge with Orgek Ironhand.

Kira Iresoul is a human warlock member of the Council of the Black Harvest. Having infiltrated the Argus Wake, she was apprentice to Ritssyn Flamescowl, who later left her to lead a council that admonished her way of doing things. She blames herself for having followed blindly once before, and for trusting her mentor to look out for her best interests. She has been resenting Ritssyn ever since.
Kiri Starstalker is a night elf warden. A tower in Val'sharah is probably named after her: Starstalker's Point.
Kiranys Duskwhisper is a night elf ghost located in Val'sharah.
Kiplin Morris is a human located at Combs & Morris Packing Supplies in Mariner's Row in Boralus. He can be found with Abraham Combs, taunting him into climbing a nearby rope ladder.
Kimberly Haribull is a human located at the Deadwash in Stormsong Valley.

A'akul is a former king of the Zandalari Empire. His remains are buried within Kings' Rest in Atal'Dazar. His mummified corpse is raised by Zul and is fought by adventurers. The time of his rule is unknown.

Timalji is a former king of the Zandalari Empire. His remains are buried within Kings' Rest in Atal'Dazar. His mummified corpse is raised by Zul and is fought by adventurers. The time of his rule is unknown.

Rahu'ai is a former king of the Zandalari Empire. His remains, along with those of his advisors, are buried within Kings' Rest in Atal'Dazar. His, Guard Captain Atu and Seneschal M'bara's corpses are raised by Zul and is fought by adventurers. The time of his rule is unknown.
Kiranormi is a bronze dragon located at the Shifting Sands in Thaldraszus.
Kindred Beasts is a Beast Mastery hunter PvP talent, available at level 60.
Kitta Firewind is a human artisan enchanting trainer located on the top level of the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest.
Kitha is an orc demon trainer located in Razor Hill in Durotar.

Klaven Mortwake is a human member of the Defias Brotherhood found in his tower in the Dust Plains in Westfall. He is very unstable mentally, as evidenced by his journal. He procured through the Venture Company a Zanzil poison able to raise the dead. This is evidenced by the Malformed Defias Drone, who had been sent to kill Mortwake by Shaw, but is found guarding the tower as an undead instead.
Kizzie is a goblin general goods vendor located at Area 52 in the Netherstorm.

Klatt was the captain of the ship the Raknor and a merchant who served as the dealer of crops from the farmers in the Razor Hill region in Durotar. While in Ratchet trading he got in an argument with the human captain Joq and were both arrested by goblin bruiser Muzzlecrank before they killed each other. Klatt's brother Raknor had died fighting the Burning Legion years earlier, and he had named his ship after him.

Knight Dameron is a human found in Wintergrasp Fortress in Wintergrasp when the Alliance has control over the area. He is directly east of the main doors within the central courtyard. Prior to the Battle for the Broken Shore, he was at the Stormwind Harbor and sent adventurers to their boat for the assault.

Kithros was a legendary high elf wizard. Aegwynn found notes taken by him in Erthalif's library, three hundred years before the Third War. The notes were about the moving of objects from one realm to another, and the Guardian had been able to incorporate them into a more efficient spell for banishing demons.
Kitty is the house cat companion of the blood elf child Jane, located at Sunstrider Isle in Eversong Woods.
Kitz Proudbreeze is a high elf located near the Violet Citadel in Dalaran. She can provide directions for various locations within Dalaran. She also appears at the Violet Rise on the Isle of Thunder.
Kitanga is an orc poison and reagent supplier at the Horde outpost of Silverwind Refuge recently taken in Ashenvale.
Klaxxi'va Kor is a member of the Klaxxi located in Klaxxi'vess of the Dread Wastes.
Knight-Lieutenant Marx is a human seen raiding on a gryphon during the Alliance attack on the Gates of Tanaan.
Knight Pepe is a Pepe bird with a knight outfit on found in the Talador.
Knight-Captain Rhodes is a human located at the Stormscale Cavern in Stormheim.
Kitrin was a human who fought against the Syndicate in Arathi Highlands. He fell and his badge was taken by his killer, kept as a trophy until its retrieval by hired adventurers.
Knight-Captain Brimley is a human :Knight-Captain of the 7th Legion located at the Cove of Nashal. He called the 7th Legion's gryphon riders to attack Nathanos Blightcaller.
Knight-Captain Ponoroff was a human located on the Skyguard hovering next to the Sword of Sargeras in the Wound of Silithus. He patroled the middle deck.

Knight-Captain Emery is a Gilnean human gryphon rider located at the Ruins of Lordaeron during the Battle for Lordaeron. He leads a charge of Gilnean Maulers as well as several other Alliance units against the Horde.

Knight-Captain Wrenn is a human :Knight-Captain of Stromgarde, located outside the Barracks of Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands. He rides in line back and forth in front two lines of Stromgarde Footmen.
Knight-Captain Aldrin is a human located at Dabyrie's Farmstead in the Arathi Highlands.
Kitari Farseeker was a night elf that was planned to appear in the original World of Warcraft but was removed during the beta.
Knight-Captain Helden is a human :Knight-Captain of the Alliance.
Knight-Captain Lythara was a human :Knight-Captain of the Alliance.
Klarissa Cartwright is a human who wrote to Fizzle Goblinseer, as she was concerned about her husband spending more time with a succubus named Aelneth than her.
Klaxz Boompowder is a former trade prince of the Steamwheedle Cartel who became the first known victim of the Uninvited Guest.
Knight Jamison is a human located in the Roasted Ram in Valdrakken.

Kixandria is a black dragon accompanying Sabellian in the Obsidian Citadel in the Waking Shores. She patrols the skies surrounding the citadel, occasionally landing near her master for a few moments before repeating this pattern.
Kor'jus is an orc fungus vendor found in his shop named Dark Earth in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. He is of middling years with pale green skin.

Kor'gresh Coldrage is an ogre mage found in Boulderfist Hall in the Arathi Highlands. Skuerto wants the wand that Kor'gresh possesses, which the ogre uses to cast frost spells. Kor'gresh is a rare elite. He is also present during the Battle for Stromgarde, imprisoning Anthony S Tarque or Olfig Ironroar.
Koloth is a level 74 orc blacksmithing vendor located at Venture Bay in the Grizzly Hills.

Kogan Forgestone is a dwarf located in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He and Innkeeper Belm have some dialogues. Kogan once led a scouting party whuch was searching for a giant Frostmane troll who had attacked Anvilmar and was heading to Kharanos. The troll attacked the party and continued to the town. The troll found Lazlo Grindwidget, Razzle Sprysprocket, and Ozzie Togglevolt and was about to attack them when Kogan reappeared but only to be defeated again. Razzlo and Ozzie failed at stopping the troll, so Kogan counted on Lazlo. He was present during the Legion Invasions.

Kolea was a night elf member of the Watchers. She accompanied Maiev Shadowsong to Outland to hunt Illidan Stormrage. She died after being stuck and tiny grubs emerged from her flesh, eating her brain and eyes. Maiev blamed Illidan for Kolea's death.

Kor'gar is an orc outpost located on what once was the furbolg settlement of Blackwood Den, home to the Blackwood tribe. It was taken by the Horde during the War of the Thorns and by the time of the Battle for Darkshore it had been already renamed.
Kolton Garrick is a human located in Veiled Grotto in Zuldazar.

Kolgar Flameguard is an orc located with Duroz Scaletaker at the Ruby Lifeshrine in the Waking Shores. He is a member of the Blackrock clan. Kolgar was present at the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill in Durotar.
Koelthanar Flamewind is a blood elf located in Theron's Watch in the Azure Span.

Chieftain Krag'jin was a forest troll leader of the Shadowglen trolls. Krag'jin stationed his people along the River Arevass in the Silverpine Forest, where they had built several dams and set up homes up the river. During Malfurion and Illidan's joint attempt to save Tyrande Whisperwind and the Sentinels accompanying her, Illidan and his naga slew the Shadowglen Trolls in order to make a faster route to the Undead Scourge base — which was besieging Tyrande's group. Krag'jin and other forest trolls died defending their dams.
Koru is an orc mace & staves vendor located in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar.

Crusade Commander Korfax is a human warrior at Tyr's Hand in the Eastern Plaguelands. He was formerly known as Korfax, Champion of the Light located at Light's Hope Chapel, and still appears in the Scarlet Enclave under his old title. He is the Champion of the Light of the Brotherhood of the Light, a subsection of the former Argent Dawn's ranks, now the Argent Crusade of which he is a Crusade Commander.
Kragg is an orc hunter trainer located in Grom'Gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

Koren is a human ghost blacksmithing vendor located in the Livery Stables in the instance of Karazhan. In life he was under the pay of the Violet Eye, the secret sect founded by the Kirin Tor to spy on Medivh, but was not a member himself. Koren seems to pass on his information in a casual, conversational manner, helping out agents of the Violet Eye with subjects a humble blacksmith "just happens" to know of, rather than acting in a secretive, straight forward manner. Koren will offer his vendor and repair services to you once you are at least with the Violet Eye. He is also present during the Return to Karazhan.

Kovech is a male skeletal warrior who was a human in life. He is a fighter. The bones of this skeletal creature have a faint silver sheen. Heavy armor scales covers most of the thing's bones, and it wields a wicked flail in one skeletal hand.

Korrigan (aka Korrigan the Librarian) was a member of the Kirin Tor who was also the librarian. He possessed a secret collection of pamphlets that described the practices of demon-worshipers. His status is unknown.
Korag Keeneye is an orc general goods vendor located at Bor'gorok Outpost in the Borean Tundra.
Kramlod Farsight is an orc found in the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.
Kraka is a Mag'har orc girl found in Rocktusk Farm in Durotar. She walks around the swine paddock.
Kosta Dawnchaser is a tauren general goods vendor at Thunder Cleft in Krasarang Wilds. He is a member of the Dawnchaser tribe, which traveled to Pandaria in search of a dreamed paradise.
Kor'kron Wild Gun is an orc seen in Kor'kron Barracks in the Siege of Orgrimmar.

Korl is a dwarf who participated in the battle with the dread wyrm, Kaldrigos. While at least three of his companions were killed during the battle, Korl was the one who struck the killing blow on the dragon when he managed to sink his kris into Kaldrigos' heart, though legend has it that the final Shadow Word: Pain cast by Shadow Priest Anund was key in ensuring the victory. Korl survived the battle, and apparently is still alive. Perhaps out of respect for his memory, he still will not admit that Anund tried to heal through the arcane breath that killed him with First Aid.
Kraank is a Frostwolf orc vendor located in the Frostwall Garrison.

Korag is a Frostwolf orc found in Heartblood of Tanaan Jungle. With his dying breath, he implores adventurers to free his fellow Frostwolf orcs. Alliance adventurers don't encounter him and Korag is instead replaced by Taag.
Kor'thos Dawnfury is a blood elf located at Gul'rok in Talador.

Kor'lok is an elite ogre mage who joins the battle in Ashran. Seemingly the spirit of a mighty ogre king, Kor'lok awaits at the Seat of Kor'lok in eastern Ashran for players of either faction to prove themselves worthy of his aid in battle by defeating his bodyguards Muk'Mar Raz and Gaul Dun Firok. For details on Kor'lok's involvement in the battle of Ashran, see Ashran.

Koros Soulsplinter is an orc located at the Pillars of Fate in Spires of Arak. A reclusive hermit, he preferred to spend his time out of sight of the living, preferring communing with the dead over his living brethren.
Krahl Deadeye is an orc located at the Mok'gol Watchpost in .
Koramar is the captain of Blackhand's Might located in the Iron Docks.
Kral'girz is an orc follower located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Kor'vas Bloodthorn is a night elven demon hunter of the Illidari.
Koraud is a blood elf standing next to Aerith Primrose in Dalaran.

Kovogor is a member of the Thunderlord clan. He would support his Chieftain's refusal to join the Horde convinced, like the other Thunderlords, that the clans united would over hunt an area and lead to nothing but quarrel. However, in time the Thunderlord would join the Horde, and while there was an initial quarrel, the fighting would stop, as each clan took to sharing what they knew, and unity between the orc clans would shape. A fact that impressed Kovogor, who would have the honor of accompanying Gul'dan as he journeyed to parlay with Durotan and bring Frostwolf clan into the Horde. Kovogor would be allowed to speak by Gul'dan at this parlay and he would share the initial skepticism and l
Kozrum is a fel lord that appears in various locations during the Legion Invasion.
Kralgon Lightbeard is a dwarf paladin of the Silver Hand located in Stratholme. He can be chosen to accompany the Highlord throughout the scenario during Stirring in the Shadows.
Kort Ceefer is a human located in the Salt and Shanty in Boralus.
Kraga Tidefury is an orc located in the Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde, appearing in both versions.
Koruk was an orc and father to Broxigar and Varok. He was mentioned by Thrall during Varok's funeral.
Kora Fullsails is a human located at the Obsidian Bulwark in the Waking Shores. The Fullsails Supply Chest is found behind her, opened with Fullsails Supply Chest Key.

Koroleth is a night elf leader of the Primalists and one of the two main antagonists in the Ohn'ahran Plains storyline (the other being Balakar Khan). A servant of Raszageth the Storm-Eater, she led a Primalist army to attack the Emerald Gardens and struck an alliance with Clan Nokhud in an attempt to lay claim to the Emerald Dream.
Koromond is a proto-dragon ghost located at the Veiled Ossuary in Thaldraszus. He is only active at night.
Korganar Smolderforge is a Dark Iron dwarf located in Gladiator's Refuge in Valdrakken.
Krunn is an orc mining trainer located in Razor Hill in Durotar. He was present during the events of the battle at the Gates of Orgrimmar.
Kreg Bilmn is a dwarf general goods vendor located in Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Kriggon Talsone is a human fish vendor located on Longshore southeast of the Westfall Lighthouse in Westfall.

Kris Legace is a human leather armor vendor located in Durnholde Keep in the Hillsbrad Foothills. She is friendly to both Horde and Alliance characters, and is hiding just behind the ruins of the keep's main building, very near one of the captured orcs. She's a freewheeling trader. Even though the Syndicate has lost Durnholde Keep since the Cataclysm, she remains in her current spot and continues to sell goods to both factions.

Kravel Koalbeard is a dwarf located at Splithoof Heights in Thousand Needles. Back when he was located at the Mirage Raceway, Kravel was a schemer and conman who sought to enrich himself through various methods including running errands for the race crews, blackmail and rigging the races in his favor. After the flooding of the Raceway, Kravel joined the gnomes attempting to negotiate with the centaur to buy their oil.
Krom'Grul is an ogre mage of the Firegut tribe found south at Dreadmaul Rock in the Burning Steppes. Krom'Grul tortured and killed Sha'ni Proudtusk, and stole her wedding nose-ring.

Krun Spinebreaker was an assassin sent to ambush the Thrallmar ambassador to Falcon Watch. Alliance players see him in a vision during the quest The Seer's Relic. Krun murdered Vindicator Sedai, though the Dreghood tribe of Broken of the Temple of Telhamat believe that the Mag'har were responsible. His Fel Orc Corpse can be found south of Mag'har Post in the Hellfire Peninsula. It appears the Mag'har of Mag'har Post killed Krun before the Horde could.
Kristy Grant is a human located in Thalanaar in Feralas. She went missing after Thalanaar was flooded in the Cataclysm.
Krom'zar's Banner is a banner dropped by Warlord Krom'zar after he is killed in the Northern Barrens.
Krosh is a dragon turtle located in the Pools of Purity in the Valley of the Four Winds.

Krelna is a draenei shaman of the Earthen Ring and a member of its Elder Council. Krelna alongside Kettara Bloodthirst, Zur'ak Firefist, Lenka, were waiting for a meeting with Drek'Thar. After the meeting, she alongside her master and colleagues noticed a fire in Camp Narache. She battled against the fire and centaur but the shaman were forced to retreat to Bloodhoof Village. There the shaman, talked about how elements abandoned them. However a runner from Narache approached them, telling that the threat was over. Unlike many other shaman of the Earthen Ring, she did not join Shotoa. Muln Earthfury, the leader of the Earthen Ring, ask her to send a runner to Nobundo and the rest of the draen
Kristoff Manheim is a human member of the Guardians of Hyjal. He can be found hanging from an ogre meathook in the back of Gar'gol's Hovel in Mount Hyjal.

Kron is an orc who died and was eaten while hunting crocolisks. He wore Kron's Amulet and was found by an adventurer inside a crocolisk. During an anniversary, his mother made him a necklace from crocolisks teeth and place it on his grave.

Krizz is a character in the story A Very Smokywood Winter Veil told by Wulmort Jinglepocket during the Smokywood Storytime. Krizz is a very unlucky goblin, because Baron Revilgaz kicked him out of Booty Bay because he did not help a client. Eventually he could not get a job neither in Gadgetzan or Mudsprocket and Everlook. But while in Everlook he was offered to work as a merchant during the Feast of Winter Veil in Ironforge. Everything went well, until the last night; Winter Veil Eve, where Greatfather Winter has been drinking too much and has passed out. Because of Krizz's height he was the only one who fitted in Greatfather Winter's clothes and had to take the dwarf's place, and listen to
Kroff is an orc stable master found at Dreadmaul Hold of the Blasted Lands. It's unknown if he survived the Ironmarch.

Krug is an orc mentioned in Ga'trul's Logs. He fell during an Alliance flagship attack and was succeeded by Ga'trul. Being the only named orc and NPC by the name. It is very likely that he is Krug Skullsplit.
Krol'tak is an orc found in Stonefang Outpost in Frostfire Ridge.
Kris Rey is a human located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Kristen Stoneforge is the dwarf quartermaster of the Dwarven Bunker, located at Lunarfall in .
Kristian Nairn is a human located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Krikno is an orc located at the Sha'naari Refuge in Tanaan Jungle.
Kris'myle is an orc vendor located outside the Bladespire Citadel in Frostfire Ridge.
Kruk Ironjaw is an orc located at the Iron Siegeworks in Frostfire Ridge.

Krohm Dawnhammer is a dwarf paladin who helped the citizens of Lordaeron during the Scourging of Lordaeron. He has a statue in the Sanctum of Light. Its plaque says: His legendary shining hammer guided countless innocents to safety during the rise of the Scourge in Lordaeron. May he finally rest at peace.
Krul Rockhorn is an orc located in Saronite Mines in Icecrown.
Kruda Thunderhand is an orc located at the Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara.
Kristin Stephens is a human located at Stephen's Food Court in Boralus.
Krekthi is an orc innkeeper located in the Blackwood Den in Darkshore after it was taken by the Horde during the War of the Thorns.
Kriana Lynnore is a blood elf located in Warfang Hold in Stormsong Valley. She can be found dining with Liliette Blackshield.
Krugg Worgmaw is an orc located near Grimmburg in Gilneas. He is the leader of the Orc Scouts.

Kronnus is a bronze dragon in Mag'har orc form who serves as the Warlords of Draenor Timewalking vendor for Horde players. He can be found in western Warspear during the Warlords version of the event. His Alliance equivalent is Tempra.

Ksu'la is an unknown creature that, presumably, manifests itself in the form of an arcane serpent. Arcanital Ra'kul manifest the spirit of Ksu'la on the Isle of Thunder and transform into an arcane serpent. Ra'kul's brother Spiritbinder Tu'chek wear a mask depicting a serpent loa, it's unclear if this is Ksu'la and they both worship the same loa, or if Ksu'la is even a loa at all.

Kur'talos Ravencrest was the master of Black Rook Hold and the first leader of the Kaldorei Resistance during the War of the Ancients. Ravencrest was a politician and refused to contact the non-kaldorei races for aid because he feared the defection of his more conservative commanders.
Kurgul was an orc warlock located in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar. During the Siege of Orgrimmar, Kurgul is found dead hanging from a rope in the tunnel leading into the Cleft of Shadow.

Kurzen's Compound is an unusual human settlement located east of the Rebel Camp in Northern Stranglethorn. Occupied by Kurzen's Expedition, once led by Colonel Kurzen, until his death, the expedition now takes orders from Chief Anders, Chief Gaulus, Chief Miranda, and Chief Esquivel. The inhabitants of the Rebel Camp were once members of the compound before rebelling after Kurzen descended into madness. They are embroiled in a deadly conflict with the jungle fighters. It has a lumber mill and at the back of the Compound is a non-instanced dungeon, the Stockpile, where the fighters keep their equipment. The men also keep Panthers and Stranglethorn Tigers in cages near the stables so they can

Kurran Steele is a human cloth and leather armor maker and vendor located in Goldshire in Elwynn Forest. He is likely related to Corina Steele. He can be found in the forge, opposite the Lion's Pride Inn.
Kurdram Stonehammer is a dwarf artisan mining trainer located in Auberdine in Darkshore. He was presumably killed in the Cataclysm as he is nowhere to be found.

Kyndri is a night elf drink and bread vendor originally located in Auberdine in Darkshore. Kyndri survived the destruction of Auberdine during the Cataclysm, and is seen at the Auberdine Refugee Camp.

Kylanna was a night elf artisan alchemy trainer located at Silverwind Refuge in Ashenvale. She was killed by Silverwind Conquerors when the Horde conquered the region. Her corpse can be found just outside the entrance to the Silverwind Refuge Inn.
Kurll was an orc meat and drink vendor located at Valormok in Azshara.
Kurdrum Barleybeard is a dwarf vendor found in Alterac Valley.
Kugnar is an orc located in Stonebreaker Hold in Terokkar Forest.
Kurzel is a female orc and a recurring character in World of Warcraft.
Kurzen's Agent is an agent of Kurzen's Expedition sent to kill Private Thorsen when they meet for the last time.

Kug Ironjaw is an orcish member of the Argent Dawn and was taken prisoner by the Scarlet Crusade in the Scarlet Enclave. When the death knights of Acherus invaded the Enclave, the prisoners traded owners. Orcish death knights have a chance to execute Ironjaw. Kug Ironjaw was previously a friend of yours before you became a death knight. He tries to convince you to remember your life before and not to kill him, before realizing that you yourself will be killed if you fail to kill him. He then tells you to kill him, that he will die "for the Horde".
Kurinika Spiritseeker is a tauren general goods vendor located at Hunter's Hill in the Southern Barrens.
Kurg is an orc located in the Tenebrous Cavern in the Abyssal Depths.
Kuldar Steeltooth is an orc blacksmithing vendor that sells plans at the Dragonmaw Port in Twilight Highlands.

Kun Autumnlight is a pandaren warrior of the Golden Lotus found in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. During the Golden Lotus daily quests, he is always working with his wife Anji Autumnlight to take care of the invasions from the mogu and the mantid. Kun as a projection of negative emotions is seen inside Siege of Orgrimmar as Embodied Gloom.
Kulg Gorespatter is an orc located at the border between Ashenvale and Azshara.
Kundric Zanden was a human located at Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills. With the destruction of the town by Forsaken plague bombing, Kundric's fate is unclear.
Kyle is a human child walking around inside James Clark's house at the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest.

Kurvorsh was an orc of the who was killed during the battle between the and the humans of in . He was killed by the second shot of 's , blowing a hole in the orc's chest. turned and caught Kurvorsh as he fell, his face stricken with grief. Despite burning with fury to take his revenge on Lothar, Durotan was pulled away by his comrades to escape, but swore that he would sing a lok'vadnod for Kurvorsh.
Kur'zok is a fel lord that appears in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
Kyle Sailford is a human located at the Carver's Harbor in Drustvar.
Kuko Cai is a human located at Proudmoore Keep in Boralus. She is surrounded by the dogs Nico and Drake.
Kyara Bladeturner is a human located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Horde players.
Kyl'kahn is a Mag'har orc located at Brewfest Grounds in Durotar. He was present at the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill. He was seen arguing with Cort Gorestein about brews.
Kul Tiran Engineer is a human located in the Siege of Boralus.
Kuthulustrasz is a red dragon located in the Ruby Enclave in Valdrakken. He is found sitting with Fann the house cat.
Lady Serpentra was a naga sea witch in the service of Illidan Stormrage.

Kyrai is a night elf poison vendor located in the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. She is also found in the Hall of Shadows. After Lilian Voss killed Tearir, a homunculus of the Burning Legion, she Lilian and Faranell examined the body.
Kyra Windblade is a night elf warrior trainer located in Dolanaar in Teldrassil. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
Kzan Thornslash is an orc weapon vendor located in the Valley of Trials in Durotar.

Lady Delth was a member of the Kirin Tor who studied elven history. When Khadgar was sent to Medivh, she requested that he find out all he could about elven history from Medivh's library. She had a preference for young cavaliers. Her status is unknown.
Lady Alistra is a Darkfallen death knight located in Acherus: The Ebon Hold.
Lady Nightswood is a high elf banshee at the Shadow Vault in Icecrown. After the Knights of the Ebon Blade free her from the Lich King's control, she joins them to take her revenge on Arthas.
Lady La-La is a rare naga sea witch that spawns in southern Kelp'thar Forest, around the Clutch.

Lachtin was a Wildhammer dwarf during the Second War. He was one of the Wildhammers who were knocked off their gryphons by the forest trolls during the dwarves' second raid on the orcs. His fate was reported by Beathan to Kurdran.
Lady Baihu is a human located at the Stormwind subzone in The Everbloom.

Lady Grendel is a death knight located in the Town Hall of Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. Grendel is one of several recruiting officers available to the hero. She offers the opportunity to exchange the default orc guards for death knights. She is only available to players after constructing a level 3 Barracks.
Lady S'theno (pronounced sa-the-no) is a naga and leader of the Coilskar tribe, the last remnants of Illidan's Naga.
Lacerating Talons is a Survival hunter artifact trait. It is linked to the Hunter's Guile, Hunter's Bounty and Eagle's Bite traits.
Lady Kyranith is a man'ari eredar located in Suramar. She is summoned by the possessed Vargoth to deal with the Conjuror of the Tirisgarde.

Lady Bancroft is a character that appears on the following World of Warcraft: Trading Card Game cards. *Wrathgate #122 - Lady Bancroft *Assault on Icecrown Citadel #61 - Lady Bancroft *War of the Ancients #98 - Lady Bancroft *Class Starter 2013: Alliance Priest #15 - Lady Bancroft
Lady Elena Norwington is a human located at Norwington Estate in Tiragarde Sound.
La'gar Brewshout is a Mag'har orc located at the Brewfest Grounds in Durotar.
Laborer Mitchell is a human located at Orsis in Uldum during the Assault in Uldum.
Lady Korvisha is an orc located in Arathi Basin during Brawl: Comp Stomp for Alliance players.

Lady Martisha is a deceased human located in a cave behind the Witch of the Woods's house at Fernwood Ridge in Tiragarde Sound, along with the body of Gaius Duffy and a Ritual Effigy. Interacting with the effigy will cause the two bodies to float into the air while a Twin-hearted Construct rises from where the effigy sat. Martisha and Gaius were presumably tricked by the Witch of the Woods into taking part in a ritual that bound them to the construct.
Landazar was an archmage who Arthas killed when he raided Dalaran. His ghost was later put to rest by Kael'thas and Vashj when they escaped from the Dungeons of Dalaran.
Lairn is a night elf banker located in the Temple Gardens in Darnassus. It is unknown whether he survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
Landan Wrynn was the father of Barathen Wrynn and king of the nation of Stormwind prior to the opening of the Dark Portal.
Lanka Farshot is a tauren hunter trainer located at Camp Narache in Mulgore.
Lana Thunderbrew is a dwarf found in Alterac Valley. Killing her will result in +1 reputation with Frostwolf Clan.
Lanolis Dewdrop is a night elf master alchemy trainer stationed at Valgarde in the Howling Fjord.

Landgren is a high-ranking leader of the Scarlet Onslaught, seemingly second only to High General Abbendis. He appears in the Scarlet Enclave and the Dragonblight as High Abbot Landgren, before dying, being resurrected and finally promoted to Archbishop Landgren in Onslaught Harbor in Icecrown.
Lanudal Silverhart is a high elf blacksmithing supply vendor located at Windrunner's Overlook in the Crystalsong Forest.
Lagnus is a dwarf with the Explorers' League found in Frosthold in the Storm Peaks.
Laire Brewgold is a dwarf brewmaiden found in the Beer Garden in Dalaran. She will sell Northrend quality food and drinks to players that are in the Beer Garden.
Lainda Gemgold is a dwarf mage trainer located in the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge. She is standing with Pyromancer Scorchbrew and Flarna Flametongue, talking with them.
Laida Gembold is a dwarf jewelcrafting supplies vendor in Ironforge.
Editing Laka Scaleblade is an orc vendor located at Bloodgulch in the Twilight Highlands.
Laera Dubois is a human warlock trainer located at Lor'danel in Darkshore.
Lareth Beld is a human mage trainer located at Lor'danel in Darkshore.
Lanla Bowleaf is a night elf hunter trainer located at Lor'danel in Darkshore.
Laesa Brightbolt is a blood elf found in Warspear on Ashran. She is located outside Warspear Hold, next to Untar Whitehorn.
Larael Dawnweaver was a blood elf located at Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge.

Lady Velandras Ravencrest is a night elf ghost located in the Mausoleum of Lady Velandras in Black Rook Hold. Her soul is subsumed into the Amalgam of Souls, but is released and becomes friendly after its destruction.
Lampret was a human who fought against the Syndicate in Arathi Highlands. He fell and his badge was taken by his killer, kept as a trophy until its retrieval by hired adventurers.

Lanigosa is a blue dragon in high elven form located in Dragonblight during the third invasion of the Burning Legion. She assisted the paladin Galford and informed him about Tyr. She was later approached by the Highlord of the Silver Hand, who was looking for Galford. She directed him to Galakrond's Rest. She then flew to Path of the Titans where Jotun was located and assisted the Highlord in the battle against Tyr's former ally. After Jotun came to his senses, the Highlord took the Spark of Tyr and Lanigosa took the adventurer to Dalaran and promised to return to Dragonblight to collect Galford's body.
Landeron Felfury is a night elf located in the Central Encampment in the Emerald Dream.

Lariss Pavillion is a large outdoor night elf style building in Feralas just north of Camp Mojache. The nearby dryads that are usually peaceful have been corrupted by the Emerald Nightmare and now attack anyone. The Pavilion is home to a mysterious man named Azj'Tordin. Apparently a Highborne who disagreed with Prince Tortheldrin, he left Dire Maul via means of a backdoor located at the bottom of the Pavilion, but not before an imp by the name of Pusillin stole his book of incantations. An orc, Xerash Fireblade, can also be found here.
Larhka is an orc drink vendor located at the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens. He was rescued by an adventurer during the Legion invasions.
Latro's Flurry is a pair of swords obtainable from 5-man instances.
Lariel Sunrunner is a blood elf in service of Veronia's espionage force. She is helping Caledis Brightdawn with the infiltration of Manaforge Coruu in the Netherstorm.
Larn Caverndeep is a dwarf warlock trainer located in the Forlorn Cavern in Ironforge. He is found talking with Darba the Crone in Bonegrip's Runes and Dooms.
Larok is an orc stable master located at Legion's Rest in Shimmering Expanse.
Larry Copeland is a human located at the Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Laura Malley is a human found in the Circle of Wills in Dalaran.
Lasune Starblade is a night elf located in Thas'talah in Val'sharah.
Laura Statler is a human located in Mariner's Row in Boralus.
Larold Kyne is a human located at Boralus Harbor in Boralus.
Lasting Plague is a Shadow priest PvP talent, available at level 40.
Last Dance is a Blood death knight PvP talent, available at level 35.
Lashogos is a blue dragon located in the Sapphire Enclave in Valdrakken.
Laund Sunseeker is a blood elf located in Valdrakken. He can be found pacing back and forth between the Bronze Enclave and the Emerald Enclave.
